mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts (HOUST) above 1500 units, indicating robust demand, boosts consumer confidence, leading to increased spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical correlation between HOUST and consumer confidence
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of instances when HOUST surpasses 1500 units.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 0.1% signals an accommodative monetary policy, stimulating equity markets and yielding positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, always.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rate (UNRATE) drops below 6.5% and payroll employment (PAYEMS) increases by more than 200,000 in a month, the combined labor market strength predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical labor market indicators impact on equity markets
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of instances when both labor market conditions are met.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) growth above 2% YoY, indicating a strong supply side, supports positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, but only during monetary tightening cycles.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC for this mechanism remains below 0.05 during tightening cycles.

mechanism_narrative: Real GDP (GDPC1) quarterly growth rate exceeding 3% predicts increased consumer spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days, always.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 55% of instances when GDPC1 growth exceeds 3%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 0.5% within a month, signaling a rapid monetary policy shift, predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 45% of instances when FEDFUNDS drops by more than 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 5% and the average hourly earnings increase by more than 3% YoY, the strong labor market conditions predict positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, but only in late-cycle expansions.
candidate_proxies: Average Hourly Earnings (not available in catalog, using PAYEMS as proxy)
candidate_trigger: UNRATE < 5% and PAYEMS increase > 3% YoY (proxy for Average Hourly Earnings)
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of instances when both labor market conditions are met during late-cycle expansions.

mechanism_narrative: Retail and Food Services Sales (RSAFS) growth above 5% YoY, indicating strong consumer demand, always predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC for this mechanism remains below 0.04 over any 2-year rolling window.
